# Echo (ECHO)

> Echo is a share sale on BNB Smart Chain. 3,000 shares of 1,000,000 ECHO each, cut from a fixed supply of 3,000,000,000. 600 shares are free (one per wallet), 2,400 are sold at 0.001 BNB each to anyone, with no per-wallet limit. Sale window: 2026-11-16 23:30 WIB to 2026-11-23 23:30 WIB.

Site: https://echoonbsc.github.io/echo/
Contract: 0x05b02A9FD0b4F58bF013b4137D84593E7a0e6546
Agent instructions: https://echoonbsc.github.io/echo/agent.md
Skill: https://echoonbsc.github.io/echo/skill.md

## Key facts

- Chain: BNB Smart Chain (56)
- Token: Echo (ECHO), 18 decimals, supply 3,000,000,000, immutable contract, no admin
- 1 share = 1,000,000 ECHO
- Free claim: claimFree(), 600 shares total, 1 per wallet, no conditions of any kind
- Buy: buy(n) with exactly n * 0.001 BNB, 2,400 shares total, open to anyone, no per-wallet cap
- Views: freeSold(), paidSold(), freeClaimed(address), PRICE, START, END, SHARE, FREE_CAP, PAID_CAP
- Transfers are unrestricted from the start; there is no pool and no trading tax
- After the window ends, anyone may call finalize() to burn the unsold reserve left in the contract
